import cv2
import numpy as np

def get_ground_pos(x_pix, y_pix, cam_x, cam_y, heading_deg):
    Z_cam = 396.8 / (y_pix - 256)
    X_cam = (x_pix - 256) * 1.55 / (y_pix - 256)
    theta = np.radians(heading_deg)
    # camera forward is [sin(theta), cos(theta)] in world (x, y)
    # camera right is [cos(theta), -sin(theta)] in world (x, y)
    world_x = cam_x + Z_cam * np.sin(theta) + X_cam * np.cos(theta)
    world_y = cam_y + Z_cam * np.cos(theta) - X_cam * np.sin(theta)
    return world_x, world_y, Z_cam

img7 = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0007.png')
# in obs_0007, pot base is near x=340..370, y=380..410
